description: This file defines API endpoints for managing and retrieving sports highlights data, using FastAPI framework. It includes routes for listing highlights, fetching details of a specific highlight, and getting latest featured highlights. The code interacts with a database through repositories and converts database models to response schemas.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of highlights, optionally filtered by match ID.
